hook.en: In 1609 Galileo pointed a simple telescope at the sky and saw moons going around Jupiter. Today the James Webb Space Telescope photographs galaxies formed billions of years ago.
hook.bm: Pada 1609 Galileo menghalakan teleskop ringkas ke langit dan melihat bulan-bulan mengelilingi Musytari. Kini Teleskop Angkasa James Webb merakam galaksi yang terbentuk berbilion tahun dahulu.

bigIdeas.en: Ideas about the universe changed from the geocentric (Earth-centred) model to the heliocentric (Sun-centred) model.
bigIdeas.bm: Idea tentang alam semesta berubah daripada model geosentrik (Bumi di pusat) kepada model heliosentrik (Matahari di pusat).

bigIdeas.en: Telescopes, rockets, satellites, probes and space stations let us explore space.
bigIdeas.bm: Teleskop, roket, satelit, kuar dan stesen angkasa membolehkan kita meneroka angkasa.

bigIdeas.en: Space technology helps daily life: communication, weather forecasting, GPS and remote sensing.
bigIdeas.bm: Teknologi angkasa membantu kehidupan harian: komunikasi, ramalan cuaca, GPS dan penderiaan jauh.

detail.en: Yuri Gagarin — first human in space
detail.bm: Yuri Gagarin — manusia pertama di angkasa

detail.en: Apollo 11 — first humans on the Moon
Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor — first Malaysian in space
detail.bm: Sheikh Muszaphar Shukor — rakyat Malaysia pertama di angkasa

definition.en: Old idea that Earth is at the centre of the universe (Ptolemy).
definition.bm: Idea lama bahawa Bumi di pusat alam semesta (Ptolemy).

definition.en: An object that orbits a planet; artificial ones are launched by rockets.
definition.bm: Objek yang mengorbit planet; satelit buatan dilancarkan oleh roket.

definition.en: Uncrewed spacecraft sent to study other bodies in space.
definition.bm: Kapal angkasa tanpa awak yang dihantar untuk mengkaji jasad lain di angkasa.

definition.en: Collecting information about Earth from satellites.
definition.bm: Mengumpul maklumat tentang Bumi daripada satelit.

question.en: Give TWO ways satellites help people in Malaysia.
question.bm: Berikan DUA cara satelit membantu rakyat Malaysia.

steps.en: Communication satellites (e.g. MEASAT) carry TV and phone signals.
steps.bm: Satelit komunikasi (cth. MEASAT) membawa isyarat TV dan telefon.

steps.en: Weather satellites help forecast heavy rain and monsoon floods.
steps.bm: Satelit cuaca membantu meramal hujan lebat dan banjir monsun.

answer.en: Also accepted: GPS navigation; remote sensing for agriculture, forests and disasters.
answer.bm: Juga diterima: navigasi GPS; penderiaan jauh untuk pertanian, hutan dan bencana.

prompt.en: Who proposed that the planets move around the Sun (heliocentric model) in 1543?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mencadangkan planet bergerak mengelilingi Matahari (model heliosentrik) pada 1543?

explanation.bm: Model Ptolemy yang lebih awal adalah geosentrik.

prompt.en: Galileo used a telescope to discover…
prompt.bm: Galileo menggunakan teleskop untuk menemui…

explanation.en: This supported the idea that not everything orbits Earth.
explanation.bm: Ini menyokong idea bahawa bukan semua objek mengorbit Bumi.

prompt.en: The first artificial satellite, launched in 1957, was…
prompt.bm: Satelit buatan pertama yang dilancarkan pada 1957 ialah…

explanation.en: It was launched by the Soviet Union.

prompt.en: Who was the first human in space (1961)?
prompt.bm: Siapakah manusia pertama di angkasa (1961)?

prompt.en: Which mission first landed humans on the Moon in 1969?
prompt.bm: Misi manakah pertama kali mendaratkan manusia di Bulan pada 1969?

explanation.en: Neil Armstrong was the first to step onto the Moon.
explanation.bm: Neil Armstrong orang pertama menjejakkan kaki di Bulan.

prompt.en: The first Malaysian to go into space (2007) was Dato' Dr Sheikh Muszaphar ______.
prompt.bm: Rakyat Malaysia pertama ke angkasa (2007) ialah Dato' Dr Sheikh Muszaphar ______.

explanation.en: He flew to the International Space Station.
explanation.bm: Beliau terbang ke Stesen Angkasa Antarabangsa.

prompt.en: The idea that Earth is at the centre of the universe is called the…
prompt.bm: Idea bahawa Bumi berada di pusat alam semesta dipanggil model…

prompt.en: What is used to launch satellites into orbit?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang digunakan untuk melancarkan satelit ke orbit?

explanation.en: Rockets carry their own fuel and oxidiser, so they work in space.
explanation.bm: Roket membawa bahan api dan pengoksidanya sendiri, jadi ia berfungsi di angkasa.

prompt.en: Arrange these events in time order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa ini mengikut kronologi.

prompt.en: Match each space technology with its use.
prompt.bm: Padankan teknologi angkasa dengan kegunaannya.

explanation.en: Each has a different job in orbit.
explanation.bm: Setiap satu mempunyai tugas berbeza di orbit.

right.bm: Mencerap bintang dan galaksi yang jauh

prompt.en: Why do space telescopes like Hubble give clearer images than telescopes on the ground?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah teleskop angkasa seperti Hubble memberi imej lebih jelas daripada teleskop di Bumi?

explanation.en: The atmosphere's movement and absorption reduce image quality.
explanation.bm: Pergerakan dan penyerapan atmosfera mengurangkan kualiti imej.

options.en: They are above the atmosphere, which blurs and absorbs light
options.bm: Ia berada di atas atmosfera, yang mengaburkan dan menyerap cahaya

options.en: They are closer to the stars by a big distance
options.bm: Ia jauh lebih dekat dengan bintang

options.en: They only work at night on Earth
options.bm: Ia hanya berfungsi pada waktu malam di Bumi

prompt.en: Which was Malaysia's first microsatellite, launched in 2000?
prompt.bm: Manakah satelit mikro pertama Malaysia, dilancarkan pada 2000?

explanation.en: Malaysia later launched RazakSAT (2009) for remote sensing.
explanation.bm: Malaysia kemudian melancarkan RazakSAT (2009) untuk penderiaan jauh.

prompt.en: Select ALL everyday uses of space technology.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA kegunaan harian teknologi angkasa.

explanation.en: Many inventions such as memory foam and water filters also came from space research.
explanation.bm: Banyak ciptaan seperti busa memori dan penapis air juga berasal daripada penyelidikan angkasa.

prompt.en: Early Muslim astronomers such as al-Battani and al-Biruni contributed by…
prompt.bm: Ahli astronomi Islam awal seperti al-Battani dan al-Biruni menyumbang dengan…

explanation.en: Their work helped later astronomers in Europe.
explanation.bm: Usaha mereka membantu ahli astronomi kemudian di Eropah.

options.en: making accurate observations and calculations of the motions of the Sun, Moon and planets
options.bm: membuat cerapan dan pengiraan yang tepat tentang gerakan Matahari, Bulan dan planet

prompt.en: The International Space Station (ISS) is…
prompt.bm: Stesen Angkasa Antarabangsa (ISS) ialah…

explanation.en: Astronauts from many countries live and do experiments there.
explanation.bm: Angkasawan dari banyak negara tinggal dan menjalankan eksperimen di situ.

prompt.en: Collecting information about Earth's surface from satellites is called remote ______.
prompt.bm: Mengumpul maklumat tentang permukaan Bumi dari satelit dipanggil ______ jauh.

explanation.en: Used for mapping forests, crops, floods and haze.
explanation.bm: Digunakan untuk memetakan hutan, tanaman, banjir dan jerebu.

prompt.en: Why was Galileo's discovery of Jupiter's moons important?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah penemuan bulan-bulan Musytari oleh Galileo penting?

explanation.en: Evidence from observation changed scientific ideas.
explanation.bm: Bukti daripada cerapan mengubah idea saintifik.

options.en: It showed that not everything orbits Earth, supporting the heliocentric model
options.bm: Ia menunjukkan bahawa bukan semua objek mengorbit Bumi, menyokong model heliosentrik

options.en: It proved the Moon is made of rock
options.bm: Ia membuktikan Bulan diperbuat daripada batu

options.en: It led directly to the first satellite
options.bm: Ia terus membawa kepada satelit pertama

options.en: It showed Jupiter is a star

prompt.en: How can remote sensing satellites help during the monsoon season in Malaysia?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah satelit penderiaan jauh boleh membantu semasa musim monsun di Malaysia?

explanation.en: Satellite images show large areas quickly.
explanation.bm: Imej satelit menunjukkan kawasan luas dengan cepat.

options.en: By mapping flooded areas so rescuers know where to go
options.bm: Dengan memetakan kawasan banjir supaya penyelamat tahu ke mana perlu pergi

prompt.en: What is a major problem caused by thousands of old satellites and rocket parts in orbit?
prompt.bm: Apakah masalah utama akibat beribu-ribu satelit lama dan serpihan roket di orbit?

explanation.en: Even small debris moves at very high speed.
explanation.bm: Serpihan kecil pun bergerak pada kelajuan yang sangat tinggi.

options.en: Space debris can collide with working satellites and spacecraft
options.bm: Sampah angkasa boleh berlanggar dengan satelit dan kapal angkasa yang masih berfungsi

prompt.en: Some people say space exploration wastes money. Which is the STRONGEST counter-argument?
prompt.bm: Sesetengah orang berkata penerokaan angkasa membazir wang. Hujah balas manakah PALING KUAT?

explanation.en: Benefits reach daily life, the economy and safety.
explanation.bm: Manfaatnya sampai kepada kehidupan harian, ekonomi dan keselamatan.

options.en: It produces technologies used daily (GPS, weather forecasts, communications) and new knowledge
options.bm: Ia menghasilkan teknologi yang digunakan setiap hari (GPS, ramalan cuaca, komunikasi) dan ilmu baharu
